# Packages tested together share one test binary. A test that starts that
# binary again, naming only a -test.run of its own, must land in its own
# package's tests: with the environment it inherits, with one it replaced
# entirely, and when TestMain runs the binary as a tool.

go test ./a ./b ./nested ./scrubbed ./tool
stdout '^ok\s+example.com/grouped/a'
stdout '^ok\s+example.com/grouped/b'
stdout '^ok\s+example.com/grouped/nested'
stdout '^ok\s+example.com/grouped/scrubbed'
stdout '^ok\s+example.com/grouped/tool'
! stderr 'this binary holds'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/grouped

go 1.27
-- a/a_test.go --
package a

import (
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestChild(test *testing.T) {
	if os.Getenv("GROUPED_CHILD") != "" {
		os.Stdout.WriteString("child of a\n")
	}
}

func TestParent(test *testing.T) {
	cmd := exec.Command(os.Args[0], "-test.run=^TestChild$", "-test.v")
	cmd.Env = append(os.Environ(), "GROUPED_CHILD=1")
	out, err := cmd.CombinedOutput()
	if err != nil {
		test.Fatalf("%v\n%s", err, out)
	}
	if !strings.Contains(string(out), "child of a") {
		test.Fatalf("the child did not run a's tests:\n%s", out)
	}
}
-- b/b_test.go --
package b

import (
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestChild(test *testing.T) {
	if os.Getenv("GROUPED_CHILD") != "" {
		os.Stdout.WriteString("child of b\n")
	}
}

func TestParent(test *testing.T) {
	exe, err := os.Executable()
	if err != nil {
		test.Fatal(err)
	}
	cmd := exec.Command(exe, "-test.run=^TestChild$", "-test.v")
	cmd.Env = append(os.Environ(), "GROUPED_CHILD=1")
	out, err := cmd.CombinedOutput()
	if err != nil {
		test.Fatalf("%v\n%s", err, out)
	}
	if !strings.Contains(string(out), "child of b") {
		test.Fatalf("the child did not run b's tests:\n%s", out)
	}
}
-- nested/nested_test.go --
package nested

import (
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

// The grandchild is started with a rebuilt argument list and an environment
// that names no unit, so the only thing left that says which package's tests
// to run is the name of the binary it was started as.
func TestChild(test *testing.T) {
	switch os.Getenv("GROUPED_DEPTH") {
	case "1":
		cmd := exec.Command(os.Args[0], "-test.run=^TestChild$", "-test.v")
		cmd.Env = []string{"GROUPED_DEPTH=2", "GO_TEST_UNIT="}
		out, err := cmd.CombinedOutput()
		os.Stdout.Write(out)
		if err != nil {
			test.Fatalf("%v\n%s", err, out)
		}
	case "2":
		os.Stdout.WriteString("grandchild of nested\n")
	}
}

func TestParent(test *testing.T) {
	cmd := exec.Command(os.Args[0], "-test.run=^TestChild$", "-test.v")
	cmd.Env = []string{"GROUPED_DEPTH=1"}
	out, err := cmd.CombinedOutput()
	if err != nil {
		test.Fatalf("%v\n%s", err, out)
	}
	if !strings.Contains(string(out), "grandchild of nested") {
		test.Fatalf("the grandchild did not run nested's tests:\n%s", out)
	}
}
-- scrubbed/scrubbed_test.go --
package scrubbed

	if os.Getenv("GROUPED_CHILD") != "" {
		os.Stdout.WriteString("child of scrubbed\n")
	}
}

func TestParent(test *testing.T) {
	cmd := exec.Command(os.Args[0], "-test.run=^TestChild$", "-test.v")
	cmd.Env = []string{"GROUPED_CHILD=1"}
	out, err := cmd.CombinedOutput()
	if err != nil {
		test.Fatalf("%v\n%s", err, out)
	}
	if !strings.Contains(string(out), "child of scrubbed") {
		test.Fatalf("the child did not run scrubbed's tests:\n%s", out)
	}
}
-- tool/tool_test.go --
package tool

import (
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"testing"
)

func TestMain(main *testing.M) {
	if os.Getenv("GROUPED_IS_TOOL") != "" {
		os.Stdout.WriteString("tool ran\n")
		os.Exit(0)
	}
	os.Setenv("GROUPED_IS_TOOL", "1")
	os.Exit(main.Run())
}

func TestTool(test *testing.T) {
	out, err := exec.Command(os.Args[0], "some", "arguments").CombinedOutput()
	if err != nil {
		test.Fatalf("%v\n%s", err, out)
	}
	if string(out) != "tool ran\n" {
		test.Fatalf("got %q, want the tool's output", out)
	}
}
